name: Zorobabel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: This Zorobabel and Salathiel are not Matthew's: here Salathiel is the son of Neri, not of Jeconiah, so this is the other Zerubbabel, Pedaiah's son, the cousin.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
